question: What is the capital adequacy requirement for Tier 1 capital under the framework?
answer: The capital adequacy requirement for Tier 1 common equity capital under the Basel IV capital adequacy standards is that it must remain above 10.5% of total risk-weighted assets at all times [1].

## Section 2: Capital Reserves & Liquidity Ratios
Under Basel IV capital adequacy standards, Tier 1 common equity capital must remain above 10.5% of total risk-weighted assets at all times. In addition, institutions must hold high-quality liquid assets (HQLA) sufficient to cover total net cash outflows over a 30-day stress period.
